prdRequirements.title: One-Tap Egypt Connect
prdRequirements.spec: Single prominent connect button routes user to their optimal Egyptian node (Standard Marseille Pool vs. Sticky 1:1 Cairo Banking Relay) displaying live RTT and assigned Egyptian IP.

prdRequirements.title: AmneziaWG + WSS 443 Stealth Engine
prdRequirements.spec: Primary tunnel uses AmneziaWG (randomized headers H1–H4 + junk packet padding) to defeat Gulf ISP & Telecom Egypt DPI. Automatic fallback within 3.5s to WireGuard-over-WSS (TLS TCP 443) if UDP is blocked.

prdRequirements.title: Banking Mode (1:1 Sticky IP Pinning)
prdRequirements.spec: Banking Plan subscribers are assigned an exclusive, static Egyptian IP (1 User : 1 IP) bound to their account in PostgreSQL and never shared with any other user.

prdRequirements.title: 1-Tap 'Egyptian Apps Only' Split-Tunnel
prdRequirements.spec: Pre-populated split-tunnel mode routes only Egyptian banking, government, telecom, and streaming apps through the VPN while keeping WhatsApp, Uber/Careem, and local Gulf bank apps on domestic internet.

prdRequirements.title: Live 15-Minute Service Status Board
prdRequirements.spec: In-app dashboard showing real-time verified status (Working / Degraded / Blocked) for top 12 Egyptian services (NBE, CIB, Banque Misr, InstaPay, Digital Egypt, PPO Fines, Watch iT, My WE, Ana Vodafone).

prdRequirements.title: Dual-Stack IPv6 Sinkhole & DNS Shield
prdRequirements.spec: Capture and blackhole all ::/0 IPv6 traffic inside VpnService / NEPacketTunnelProvider so dual-stack Gulf 5G networks never leak real Saudi/UAE IPv6 addresses. Force encrypted in-tunnel Egyptian DNS.

prdRequirements.title: Pre-Flight Banking Readiness Check
prdRequirements.spec: 1-second diagnostic before opening a bank app verifying: (1) Tunnel up, (2) Sticky EG IP active, (3) IPv6 blocked, and (4) Optional warning if GPS location permission is enabled for the banking app.

prdRequirements.title: Self-Serve 1-Tap Sticky IP Swap
prdRequirements.spec: Allows Banking Tier users to swap their dedicated IP for a fresh warm-reserve IP from a different Egyptian subnet/ASN if they encounter a block or CAPTCHA (capped at 2 swaps/month).

prdRequirements.title: Bilingual Arabic-First RTL & English UI
prdRequirements.spec: Natural Egyptian Arabic RTL interface with instant English switch and clear onboarding explaining Egyptian SIM roaming requirements for bank SMS OTPs.

prdRequirements.title: Localized GCC & Global Billing
prdRequirements.spec: RevenueCat integration over Google Play Billing & Apple StoreKit 2 supporting SAR, AED, KWD, QAR, USD, EUR, and GBP price tiers with a 3-day free trial on Annual plans.

prdRequirements.title: Destination-Allowlisted Diskless Cairo Relays
prdRequirements.spec: Cairo Tier 2 relays run in RAM (tmpfs) with zero PII and enforce kernel nftables rules allowing only HTTPS traffic to Egyptian bank ASNs and .gov.eg / .com.eg CIDRs.

prdRequirements.title: Outbound Abuse & Reputation Firewall
prdRequirements.spec: Block outbound SMTP mail ports (25, 465, 587), BitTorrent/P2P signatures, and port scanning across all nodes to keep IPQS fraud scores < 25.

prdRequirements.title: 15-Minute Synthetic Unlock Monitor
prdRequirements.spec: Headless probes test every exit IP every 15 minutes against target Egyptian services, triggering alerts and auto-rotation from the 25% warm reserve on failure.

prdRequirements.title: Zero Ad / Zero Tracker Hygiene
prdRequirements.spec: 0 third-party ad SDKs, 0 behavioral trackers, and 0 dangerous phone-state permissions—verified in CI via MobSF and Exodus Privacy.

prdRequirements.title: Latency & Connect Time SLA
prdRequirements.spec: Connect time ≤ 2.0s on AmneziaWG (≤ 3.5s on WSS fallback); peak RTT ≤ 75ms from Gulf, ≤ 80ms from Europe, ≤ 185ms from North America.

prdRequirements.title: MASA Level 2 & Store Policy Readiness
prdRequirements.spec: Full compliance with Google Play VpnService policy, Apple Guideline 5.4 Organization rules, and OWASP MASVS / MASA Level 2 assessment for the Google Play Verified VPN badge.

roadmapPhases.title: Empirical Validation, Candidate IP Audit & Legal Gate
deliverables: Run Play/App Store review scraper across SWS VPN Egypt, Hola, Planet VPN, Proton, CyberGhost, and ExpressVPN.
Rent 5 candidate IPs (LightNode Cairo, Link Data Center, IT EGY, Raya Data Center, and 1 Marseille Geo-EG /29 block).
Score all 5 candidate IPs across MaxMind, IP2Location, ipinfo, DB-IP, IPQS, Scamalytics, and live tests on 10 Egyptian services from KSA, UAE, UK, and US.
Obtain written legal opinion from Egyptian telecom counsel on all 7 Stage 4 questions and complete offshore LLC/FZCO + D-U-N-S setup.
roadmapPhases.gateCriteria: ≥ 90% unlock pass rate on candidate IPs, IPQS < 25 on Banking IPs, and written legal sign-off.

roadmapPhases.title: Two-Tier Hybrid Infrastructure & Synthetic Status Engine
deliverables: Build Ansible playbooks deploying hardened Ubuntu 24.04 nodes with AmneziaWG (UDP) and WireGuard-over-WSS (TLS 443).
Configure diskless RAM-only Cairo relays with nftables allowlists for Egyptian banking ASNs and .gov.eg CIDRs.
Build Control Plane API (FastAPI/Go + PostgreSQL) for 1:1 sticky IP assignment, RevenueCat webhooks, and 25% reserve pool rotation.
Deploy 15-minute synthetic Playwright probes feeding the Live Service Status API.
roadmapPhases.gateCriteria: All peak latency/throughput benchmarks met across 7-day hourly mtr/iperf3 runs from Gulf, EU, and US.

roadmapPhases.title: Android Kotlin Client MVP, Split-Tunnel & Security Verification
deliverables: Build native Kotlin Jetpack Compose client with Arabic-first RTL UI and English toggle.
Implement 1-tap 'Egyptian Apps Only' Split-Tunnel preset, strict ::/0 IPv6 sinkhole, and encrypted in-tunnel DNS.
Add Pre-Flight Banking Readiness Check and self-serve 1-tap 'Swap My Sticky IP' action.
Pass MobSF static/dynamic scan and Exodus Privacy audit with 0 trackers and 0 high findings; record Play VpnService video.
roadmapPhases.gateCriteria: Zero DNS/WebRTC/IPv6 leaks on dual-stack networks and 0 trackers in MobSF/Exodus.

roadmapPhases.title: 200-User Gulf Closed Beta, $1,500 Paid UA Test & iOS Launch
deliverables: Run 4-week Google Play Closed Testing beta with 150–200 Egyptian expats in KSA, Kuwait, and UAE.
Execute $1,500 paid creative smoke test across Meta Reels (50%), TikTok (30%), and Google App Campaigns (20%).
Enable RevenueCat localized SAR/AED/KWD/USD billing in Weeks 11–12 to measure trial conversion and refund rates.
Ship Swift iOS client (NEPacketTunnelProvider) under Organization account and initiate MASA Level 2 audit for Play Verified badge.
